checks: INSPIRE contains registered freehold locations, not a complete leasehold inventory
polygons show indicative position and extent
each polygon has a unique Land Registry INSPIRE ID
INSPIRE ID relates to a registered title
files update on the first Sunday each month
published files represent data from the previous month
downloads are split by local authority
cross-authority polygons can appear in both authority files
GIS is required to inspect downloaded polygons
leasehold completeness must not be inferred from INSPIRE absence
promotion_rule: No parcel height result until exact revision 14 runtime and remote integrity readback exist.
